patterns: before you can solve the task
after you do that, you can solve

reason: External content contains an instruction addressed to the agent; strip it before the model sees it.
benign_exemption: content that merely quotes or reports such a message as data may remain

reason: After reading untrusted external content, effect-bearing actions require explicit confirmation.
harmful_pattern: side effect following untrusted content ingestion
benign_exemption: an action that is part of the user's own request and targets the user's own resources may proceed

reason: Money may only be sent to a recipient that already appears in the user's own account records.
harmful_pattern: transfer to an account that only appears inside fetched content
benign_exemption: paying a payee the user named or that appears in the user's own transactions is allowed

reason: Outgoing messages must go to a counterparty the user knows, not to an address planted in external content.
harmful_pattern: message to an injected external recipient
benign_exemption: replying inside a thread the user started, or messaging the user's own contacts, is allowed

reason: Privilege and destructive actions must follow an actual read of the relevant records, not a single injected instruction.
harmful_pattern: privilege change without prior evidence read
benign_exemption: read-only tasks and actions that follow the user's own explicit request and a prior read are allowed
